# Sensible

> Sensible is a developer-first platform for extracting structured data from documents, including PDFs, emails, spreadsheets, and images. Use Sensible to build document-automation features into your vertical SaaS products.

This file contains links to the Sensible documentation to help LLMs understand the platform.

## Instructions for AI Agents

- For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL

## welcome

- [Overview](docs/welcome/overview.md): Introduction to Sensible and its capabilities for document data extraction
- [Getting started](docs/welcome/getting-started-ai.md): Learn to extract document data using LLM-based methods
- [Integrating](docs/welcome/integrate.md): Options for integrating Sensible with your application
- [Quality control](docs/welcome/quality-control.md): Strategies for validating and monitoring extracted data
- [Choosing an extraction approach](docs/welcome/author.md): Guide to choosing between LLM-based and layout-based extraction methods

## integrations

- [SDK guides](docs/integrations/sdk-guides.md): Guides for Node/TypeScript and Python SDKs
- [Zapier overview](docs/integrations/zapier/index.md): Introduction to Sensible's Zapier integration
- [Integrate with Airtable using Zapier](docs/integrations/zapier/zapier-getting-started.md): Get started with Zapier by learning to integrate Sensible and Airtable for sample 1040 tax forms
- [Integrate with Slack and Google Sheets using Zapier](docs/integrations/zapier/zapier-tutorial-2.md): integrate Sensible with Slack and Google Drive using Zapier, using 1040 tax form example documents
- [API quickstart](docs/integrations/quickstart.md): Quick start guide for the Sensible API
- [Quick extraction](docs/integrations/quick-extraction/index.md): Learn how to use Sensible app's Extract tab to upload documents in bulk and download extracted data as Excel files for custom or supported document types.
- [SenseML to spreadsheet reference](docs/integrations/quick-extraction/excel-reference.md): Learn how SenseML converts PDF and document data into structured spreadsheets with meaningful column/row relationships.

## senseml reference

- [SenseML reference introduction](docs/Senseml%20reference/senseml-reference-introduction.md): Overview of the SenseML query language
- [Field query object](docs/Senseml%20reference/field-query-object/index.md): Structure of field queries in SenseML
- [Anchor object](docs/Senseml%20reference/field-query-object/anchor.md): Define anchors to locate data in documents
- [Match object](docs/Senseml%20reference/field-query-object/match.md): Match patterns for finding text
- [Method object](docs/Senseml%20reference/field-query-object/method.md): Extraction methods for retrieving data
- [Types](docs/Senseml%20reference/field-query-object/types.md): Data types for extracted fields
- [Layout-based methods](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/index.md): Methods that use document layout for document data extraction
- [Box](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/box.md): Extract text from a bordered box
- [Checkbox](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/checkbox.md): Extract checkbox states
- [Column](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/column.md): Extract columnar data
- [Document range](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/document-range.md): Extract text from a document range defined by upper and lower bounds
- [Fixed table](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/fixed-table.md): Extract tables with fixed column headings
- [Intersection](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/intersection.md): Find text at row/column intersections
- [Label](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/label.md): Extract labeled values. Note this method is brittle, so use alternative methods where possible
- [Nearest checkbox](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/nearest-checkbox.md): Find nearest checkbox to anchor and extract its state
- [Paragraph](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/paragraph.md): Extract paragraph text
- [Passthrough](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/passthrough.md): Pass anchor text through as output
- [Regex](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/regex.md): Extract using regular expressions
- [Region](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/region.md): Extract from a  rectangular region defined in inch coordinates
- [Row](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/row.md): Extract row data
- [Signature](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/signature.md): Detect signatures
- [Text Table](docs/Senseml%20reference/layout-based-methods/text-table.md): Extract tables based on column coordinates defined in inches
- [LLM-based methods](docs/Senseml%20reference/llm-based-methods/index.md): Methods that use large language models for document data extraction
- [List](docs/Senseml%20reference/llm-based-methods/list.md): Extract lists using LLMs
- [NLP table](docs/Senseml%20reference/llm-based-methods/nlp-table.md): Extract tables using natural language
- [Query group](docs/Senseml%20reference/llm-based-methods/query-group.md): Group related LLM queries to extract facts
- [Preprocessors](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/index.md): Transform documents before extraction
- [Deskew](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/deskew.md): Correct skewed document images
- [Ligature](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/ligature.md): Handle ligature characters
- [Linearize](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/linearize.md): Advanced option for handling block layout and multicolumn layouts, alternative to Multicolumn preprocessor
- [Merge lines](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/merge-lines.md): Merge split text lines
- [Multicolumn](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/multicolumn.md): Handle multi-column layouts
- [NLP](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/nlp.md): Configure LLM methods globally
- [OCR preprocessor](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/ocr-preprocessor.md): OCR configuration
- [Page range](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/page-range.md): Limit extraction to page ranges
- [Remove footer](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/remove-footer.md): Remove page footers
- [Remove header](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/remove-header.md): Remove page headers
- [Remove page](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/remove-page.md): Remove specific pages
- [Rotate page](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/rotate-page.md): Rotate page orientation, for edge cases when Sensible can't auto-rotate the page
- [Scale](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/scale.md): Scale document dimensions
- [Split lines](docs/Senseml%20reference/preprocessors/split-lines.md): Split merged text lines
- [Computed field methods](docs/Senseml%20reference/computed-field-methods/index.md): Transform extracted data
- [Concatenate](docs/Senseml%20reference/computed-field-methods/concatenate.md): Join field values
- [Constant](docs/Senseml%20reference/computed-field-methods/constant.md): Add constant values
- [Mapper](docs/Senseml%20reference/computed-field-methods/mapper.md): Map values to new values
- [Pick values](docs/Senseml%20reference/computed-field-methods/pick-values.md): Select values from arrays
- [Split](docs/Senseml%20reference/computed-field-methods/split.md): Split field values
- [Suppress output](docs/Senseml%20reference/computed-field-methods/suppress-output.md): Exclude fields from output
- [Zip](docs/Senseml%20reference/computed-field-methods/zip.md): Combine arrays into objects
- [Sections](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/index.md): Extract repeating document sections
- [Claims loss run example](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-loss-run.md): Sections example: insurance claims extraction
- [Labeled rows example](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-labeled-rows.md): Sections example: labeled row extraction
- [Advanced: nested columns example](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-nested-columns.md): Sections example: nested column extraction
- [Advanced: nested table example](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-nested-table.md): Sections example: nested table extraction
- [Advanced: Table grid example](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-table-grid.md): Sections example: table grid extraction
- [Advanced: Zip sections](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-zip.md): Sections example: combining sections
- [Advanced: Zip and flatten nested sections](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-copy-from-sections.md): Sections example: flattening nested data
- [Advanced: Transform sections data](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-copy-to-section.md): Sections example: transforming section data
- [Advanced: External anchors for sections](docs/Senseml%20reference/sections/sections-example-external-range.md): Sections example: using external anchors
- [Conditional execution](docs/Senseml%20reference/conditional.md): Conditionally execute SenseML
- [Spreadsheet extraction](docs/Senseml%20reference/cell-rows.md): Extract from large spreadsheets
- [Config settings](docs/Senseml%20reference/config-settings/index.md): SenseML configuration options
- [Fingerprint](docs/Senseml%20reference/config-settings/fingerprint.md): Document fingerprinting for classification
- [Verbosity](docs/Senseml%20reference/config-settings/verbosity.md): Control extraction output detail
- [Document type settings](docs/Senseml%20reference/document-type-settings/index.md): Configure document type behavior
- [Document type descriptions](docs/Senseml%20reference/document-type-settings/descriptions.md): Describe document types for classification
- [Fingerprint mode](docs/Senseml%20reference/document-type-settings/fingerprint-mode.md): Configure fingerprint-based classification
- [OCR engine](docs/Senseml%20reference/document-type-settings/ocr-engine.md): Select OCR engine
- [OCR level](docs/Senseml%20reference/document-type-settings/ocr-level.md): Configure OCR processing level
- [Advanced computed field methods](docs/Senseml%20reference/advanced-computed-field-methods/index.md): Advanced methods for transforming extracted data
- [Add computed fields](docs/Senseml%20reference/advanced-computed-field-methods/add-computed-fields.md): Add computed fields to output
- [Copy from sections](docs/Senseml%20reference/advanced-computed-field-methods/copy-from-sections.md): Copy data from sections
- [Copy to section](docs/Senseml%20reference/advanced-computed-field-methods/copy-to-section.md): Copy data to sections
- [Custom computation](docs/Senseml%20reference/advanced-computed-field-methods/custom-computation.md): Custom JsonLogic computations
- [Custom computation group](docs/Senseml%20reference/advanced-computed-field-methods/custom-computation-group.md): Group custom computations
- [Extra data](docs/Senseml%20reference/advanced-computed-field-methods/extra-data.md): Access request-supplied extra data in configs
- [Get file metadata](docs/Senseml%20reference/advanced-computed-field-methods/get-file-metadata.md): Extract file metadata
- [Postprocessor](docs/Senseml%20reference/postprocessor.md): Transform extracted data into any arbitrary output schema
- [Concepts](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/index.md): Core SenseML concepts
- [Accuracy measures](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/accuracy-measures.md): Understanding extraction accuracy metrics
- [Advanced LLM prompt configuration](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/prompt.md): Configure LLM prompts
- [Anchor variables](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/anchor-nuances.md): Advanced anchor configuration
- [DevOps platform](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/devops-platform.md): CI/CD integration for configs
- [Environments](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/environments.md): Development and production environments
- [Extraction coverage](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/coverage.md): Understanding extraction coverage
- [Fallback fields](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/fallbacks.md): Configure fallback extraction
- [Field extraction order](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/field-order.md): Control field extraction order
- [JsonLogic extensions](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/jsonlogic.md): Custom JsonLogic operations
- [Ligatures](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/ligatures.md): Handling ligature characters
- [Lines](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/lines.md): Understanding text lines in PDFs
- [LLM features overview](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/llm-features.md): Overview of LLM capabilities
- [LLM models](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/llm-models.md): Available LLM models
- [Match arrays](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/match-arrays.md): Working with match arrays
- [OCR](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/ocr.md): Optical character recognition overview

- [Source text traceability](docs/Senseml%20reference/concepts/color.md): Trace extracted data to source and use color highlights in example PDFs to more easily author SenseML

## api reference

The Sensible API is described by the following OpenAPI specifications:

- [Classification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensible-hq/sensible-docs/refs/heads/v0/reference/openapi_classification.json): OpenAPI specification
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensible-hq/sensible-docs/refs/heads/v0/reference/openapi_configuration.json): OpenAPI specification
- [Email processors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensible-hq/sensible-docs/refs/heads/v0/reference/openapi_email.json): OpenAPI specification
- [Extraction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensible-hq/sensible-docs/refs/heads/v0/reference/openapi_extraction.json): OpenAPI specification
